record_scope_reconstruction: Only Kyinsankyawt cargo gate is selected for the November 26 2021 endpoint. China-side Wanding Mangman and Myanmar Jinsanjiao/Henong form this channel; Pangsai–Wanding town bridge is excluded from that reopening.

source_checks.finding: November 27 Chinese broadcaster reports actual November 26 Mangman and opposite Jinsanjiao cargo restoration after 136 days, using contactless containers.
Myanmar official report retrospectively gives November 26 2021 and separately May 2022 driver substitution and January 2023 Mang Wein resumption.
